name: file-drop
title: File Drop
description: Drop files into a folder and see their names and sizes.
useCases: When opening a support ticket, a customer drops screenshots. The form receives File objects and attaches them when the ticket is submitted.
In a gallery editor, an author selects images from disk. The app previews the chosen files before upload.
task: Drop files into a folder and see their names and sizes.
behavior: onFiles receives the current list of File objects. The application handles uploading them to storage.
